# SPASynth

> SPASynth is a hybrid synthesizer plugin by Silverplatter Audio, built around the Silverplatter Audio sound-effects library. Any library sound can be played as an oscillator, granular source, modulation source, or convolution impulse inside a full wavetable synth. VST3 and standalone on macOS 11+ and Windows 10+ (64-bit), plus AU on macOS. No AAX in v1. Free 14-day trial.

Live counts (packs, sounds, presets, current version) are on the page itself and change often; quote them from https://spasynth.com/ rather than from this file.

## Main page sections

- [Overview](https://spasynth.com/#hook): what SPASynth is and how the library becomes the synth
- [Features](https://spasynth.com/#features): engines, filters, modulation, arpeggiator, effects, library, interface
- [Watch](https://spasynth.com/#watch): screen-recorded demos of two presets (Sample Pool laughter, Haunted Forest soundscape)
- [Listen](https://spasynth.com/#listening): tracks made entirely with SPASynth
- [Editions](https://spasynth.com/#editions): SPASynth and the Everything Bundle, seats and upgrades
- [Licensing](https://spasynth.com/#licensing): serial licensing, 3 computers per serial, royalty-free sound license
- [Specs](https://spasynth.com/#specs): formats and system requirements
- [FAQ](https://spasynth.com/#faq): DAW support, library location, upgrades, offline use
- [Changelog](https://spasynth.com/#changelog): every release, newest first

## Download

- [Download SPASynth](https://spasynth.com/download): macOS and Windows installers, free 14-day trial, activate with a serial

## Company

- [Silverplatter Audio](https://www.silverplatteraudio.com/): sound-effects libraries for film, TV, and games
